SELECT count(1) R3S13 FROM ( select T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetId, T10.FINPROD_ID assetCode, T10.FINPROD_ABBR assetName, 'R3S13' as remType, concat(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(T8.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d'),'') , '存款到期') reminder,
T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T8.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS from (select T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE,
t7.PAY_DATE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) QTY, T6.CASH_TYPE, T6.CASH_ID, T6.MDATE, T1.CDATE, (T6.CASH_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) fpriceAmt, /*理论本息总额*/ case t6.CASH_TYPE when '01' then 0 else (T6.PRIN_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) end prinAmt, /*还本金额*/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, (t6.INT_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) intAmt, /*理论利息*/ t6.PAY_DATE from PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T6 on t1.cdate < t6.mdate and t1.finprod_id=t6.finprod_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and T6.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and T6.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'A' AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and T6.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and T6.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) and T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T1.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' /* and T1.cdate = T6.mdate_unadjust*/ and T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP ON PSP.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCP.MDATE < T6.MDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSP.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and FCP.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and FCP.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'A' AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSP.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and FCP.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and FCP.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) and t6.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID and PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND PSP.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND FCP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' and PSP.AMOUNT > 0) where T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName})) T7 /*add by yejiejie 2019-3-9*/ group by T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE /*add by yejiejie 2019-3-9*/ ) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T9 ON T8.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T9.MDATE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = #{R3S13} where 1 = 1 AND ( T8.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T8.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S13} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID ) GROUP BY T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID , T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.FINPROD_ABBR , t8.MDATE, T5.MENU_ID, URL, LABLE, DEALF, CLOSF, DAYS ORDER BY T8.MDATE /*撤销数据*/
) zz

SELECT count(1) R3S14 FROM (
SELECT T4.FINPROD_ID, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME, 'R3S14' as remType, concat(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(T1.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d'),'') , '付息还本到期') reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T1.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON T1.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999' LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = 'R3S14' WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F03', 'F02') and t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND ( T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) and T3.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN ('T22', 'T23') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F03', 'F02') and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S14} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID )
) zz

SELECT count(1) R3S15 FROM ( SELECT T4.FINPROD_ID assetId, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID assetCode, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME assetName, 'R3S15' as remType, concat(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(T1.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d'),'') , '付息还本到期') reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T1.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON T1.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999' LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = 'R3S15' WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F05', 'F04') and t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND ( T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) and T3.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN ('T22', 'T23') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F05', 'F04') and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S15} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID ) ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC ) zz

SELECT count(1) R6S1 FROM ( select #{R6S1} as remType,REP_REVEAL.PRODID as finprodId,REP_REVEAL.PRODID as prodId,REP_REVEAL.PROD_NAME as finprodName,'净值披露查看' as reminder,
REP_REVEAL.REVEAL_END_DATE as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS from REP_REVEAL,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 where T5.REM_TYPE=#{R6S1} and REP_REVEAL.UPDATE_TIME<= #{quaryDate}+1 and REP_REVEAL.UPDATE_TIME>=#{quaryDate}-T5.DAYS and not exists (select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R6S1} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=REP_REVEAL.PRODID and DATE_FORMAT(S.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(REP_REVEAL.REVEAL_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) ) zz

SELECT count(1) R7S1 FROM ( select #{R7S1} as remType, MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE as assetId, MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE as assetCode, (case when MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE = '01' then MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME else FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR end) as assetName, '债项和主体评级变动查看' as reminder, MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS from MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO on MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID=MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE and MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE='01' left join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE and MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE='02' ,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 where T5.REM_TYPE=#{R7S1} and MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME<=#{quaryDate}+1 and MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME>=#{quaryDate}-T5.DAYS and MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE in('01','02') and not exists (select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R7S1} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE and DATE_FORMAT(S.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING MBCR WHERE MBCR.O_CODE = MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE AND MBCR.O_TYPE = MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE AND MBCR.GRADE_DATE < MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.GRADE_DATE AND DATE_FORMAT(MBCR.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')<
DATE_FORMAT(MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) union all select #{R7S1} as remType, MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE as assetId, MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE as assetCode, (case when MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE = '01' then MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME else FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR end) as assetName, '债项和主体评级变动查看' as reminder, MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS from MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO on MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID=MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE and MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE='01' left join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE and MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE='02' ,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 where T5.REM_TYPE=#{R7S1} and MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME<=#{quaryDate}+1 and MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME>=#{quaryDate}-T5.DAYS and MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE in('01','02') and not exists (select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R7S1} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE and DATE_FORMAT(S.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING MICR WHERE MICR.O_CODE = MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_CODE AND MICR.O_TYPE = MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.O_TYPE AND MICR.GRADE_DATE < MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.GRADE_DATE AND DATE_FORMAT(MICR.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') < DATE_FORMAT((MST_INNER_CREDIT_RATING.UPDATE_TIME), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) ) zz

SELECT count(1) R7S2 FROM ( select #{R7S2} as remType, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as prodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodName, '项目类资产标的信息被修改查看' as reminder, FIN_PRODUCT.UPDATE_TIME as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS from FIN_PRODUCT,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finType_F18} and T5.REM_TYPE=#{R7S2} and FIN_PRODUCT.UPDATE_TIME<= #{quaryDate}+1 and FIN_PRODUCT.UPDATE_TIME>=#{quaryDate}-T5.DAYS and not exists (select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R7S2} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and DATE_FORMAT(S.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(FIN_PRODUCT.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')) ) zz

SELECT count(1) R3S16 FROM ( select #{R3S16} as remType, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID as assetId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as assetCode, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as assetName, CONCAT('债券借贷融出的券',IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d'),''),'到期') as reminder, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.MDATE as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL inner join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT on FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID inner join FIN_DEAL_TARGET on FIN_DEAL_TARGET.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_TARGET.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID ,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 where T5.REM_TYPE=#{R3S16} and FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.MDATE<=#{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2='F30' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = 'T01' and not exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 where T2.FINPROD_ID=TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID and T2.PS='T07' and T2.FINPROD_TYPE2='F30' and T2.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} and T2.IS_CANCEL = 'N') and not exists (select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R3S16} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID and DATE_FORMAT(S.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) ) zz

select count(1) R7S3 from ( SELECT DISTINCT #{R7S3} AS remType, fp.finprod_market_id assetCode, fp.Finprod_Abbr assetName, concat(( CASE when fp.manager = null then ( case when fp.sponsor = null then ( case when fp.invest_adviser = NULL then ( case when fp.ISSUER = NULL then '融资人' else '发行人' end ) else '投资顾问' end ) else '担保人' end ) else '管理人' END),'存在声誉风险') AS reminder, mci.CUSTOMER_ID AS orgId, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME AS orgName, sas.MENU_ID AS menuId, sas.URL, sas.LABLE AS lable, sas.DEALF AS dealF, sas.CLOSF AS closF, sas.DAYS FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET sas ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON mci.CUSTOMER_ID = (CASE when fp.manager = null then ( case when fp.sponsor = null then ( case when fp.invest_adviser = NULL then ( case when fp.ISSUER = NULL then fp.financier else fp.ISSUER end ) else fp.invest_adviser end ) else fp.sponsor end ) else fp.manager END) WHERE sas.REM_TYPE =#{R7S3} AND fp.finprod_type2 IN ('F01','F06','F07','F10','F17','F18') AND mci.Customer_Id IN (select org.orgid from (SELECT DISTINCT
zz.issuer as orgId FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t2.issuer, t2.financier, t2.manager, t2.sponsor, t2.invest_adviser FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t2 ON t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID WHERE t1.amount != 0 and ( t2.issuer IS NOT NULL OR t2.financier IS NOT NULL OR t2.manager IS NOT NULL OR t2.sponsor IS NOT NULL OR t2.invest_adviser IS NOT NULL ) ) zz union
